unitOnFieldDefinition.specialTeams: excluded; possession does not identify kicking formations
unitOnFieldDefinition.paused: false during halftime, between periods, awaiting overtime or awaiting final confirmation
unitOnFieldDefinition.unknown: null only when live unit state is unavailable
unitOnFieldDefinition.display: known on-field count; zero shown even when paused or possession is unavailable; reason flags retained

liveProbabilityModel.method: Player Normal increments with shared NFL-game effects

parameters.selectedBy: Lower combined 2023-2025 held-out matchup Brier than NIG; same means and variance

model.model: EB 35% adjusted Potential + 55% Starter + 10% Roster / NIG
model.potential_input: 35% availability-adjusted Potential + 55% Starter Strength + 10% Roster Strength

potential_points.validation: 2023 selection; rolling 2024-2025 holdout; residual downward bias remains
